question: Is the following claim true? The capital of Kazakhstan is Almaty.
source: author-written for this project; verified by the author

claims.text: The claim that Almaty is the capital of Kazakhstan is false.
The government moved the capital to Astana in 1997, and it has been the capital since.
Almaty is Kazakhstan's largest city and main commercial and cultural center.
Almaty's size and prominence make it easy to mistake for the capital.
Almaty was the capital during the Soviet period and early independence, so it appears in older sources.
The seat of government, parliament, and presidency have been in Astana since 1997.
Astana was renamed Nur-Sultan in 2019 and changed back to Astana in 2022, remaining the capital throughout.
Current official status is the decisive consideration, and Almaty lacks capital status.
The claim reflects Almaty's former status or size rather than its present capital status.
